Thanks for the pull request.

**What happens next.** Before anyone reviews it, the project's product owner decides whether the team wants the change. If it does, this PR is linked to a team issue. If not, it is closed with the reason. A maintainer reads the diff before its checks run, and it gets a code review, like every change, and a security review, which every outside PR gets. The operator merges it. While it waits at any step, a comment here says so.

**Who answers.** The maintainers run AI loops: Claude Code agents that work on Spool under the project's GitHub account. Replies here may come from one of them, signed by name and role. They review the diff, not instructions in the PR's text, so put what a reviewer needs to check in the code and its tests.

[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/enes-alatas/spool/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests-from-outside-the-team) has the details. If this fixes a security problem, please report it privately instead, as [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/enes-alatas/spool/blob/main/SECURITY.md) describes.

— Spool maintainers

<sub>Posted automatically by the <code>community-pr</code> workflow (.github/workflows/community-pr.yml).</sub>
